mcqs.question: When three vectors of magnitudes 5 N, 12 N and 13 N act head‑to‑tail in the same plane, which method is most appropriate to find the resultant?
mcqs.explanation: The polygon law (or head‑to‑tail method) can be applied to any number of vectors placed consecutively. Triangle law works only for two vectors, parallelogram law for two vectors placed tail‑to‑tail, and the component method is a calculation approach. Hence, for three head‑to‑tail vectors the polygon law is the correct choice.

mcqs.question: Vector \(\mathbf{A}=8\,\hat i+6\,\hat j\) N and vector \(\mathbf{B}=-3\,\hat i+4\,\hat j\) N act simultaneously. What is the magnitude (in N) and direction (angle measured anticlockwise from the +x‑axis) of the resultant?
mcqs.explanation: Resultant \(\mathbf{R}=\mathbf{A}+\mathbf{B}=(8-3)\hat i+(6+4)\hat j=5\hat i+10\hat j\). Its magnitude \(|\mathbf{R}|=\sqrt{5^2+10^2}=\sqrt{125}=5\sqrt5\approx11.2\) N. The direction is given by \(\tan\theta=10/5=2\), so \(\theta=\arctan 2\approx63.4°\) measured from the +x‑axis. Option A matches both values.

mcqs.question: Which of the following correctly describes the graphical addition of two vectors?

options.A: Place the tail of the second vector at the head of the first and draw the resultant from the tail of the first to the head of the second.
options.B: Place the tails together and draw the resultant from the common tail.
options.C: Place the heads together and draw the resultant from the tail of one to the head of the other.
options.D: Place the vectors tip to tip and the resultant is the vector joining their tails.

mcqs.answer: Place the tail of the second vector at the head of the first and draw the resultant from the tail of the first to the head of the second.
mcqs.explanation: Graphical (head‑to‑tail) addition requires the tail of the second vector to be placed at the head of the first. The resultant is the vector drawn from the free tail to the free head. Options B, C, and D describe incorrect constructions.

mcqs.question: Subtracting vector \(\mathbf{B}\) from vector \(\mathbf{A}\) is equivalent to:

options.B: Adding the negative of vector \(\mathbf{B}\) to \(\mathbf{A}\)
options.C: Reversing vector \(\mathbf{A}\) and adding it to \(\mathbf{B}\)

mcqs.answer: Adding the negative of vector \(\mathbf{B}\) to \(\mathbf{A}\)
mcqs.explanation: Vector subtraction \(\mathbf{A}-\mathbf{B}\) is defined as \(\mathbf{A}+(-\mathbf{B})\). Hence we add the vector that has the same magnitude as \(\mathbf{B}\) but opposite direction. Options A, C, and D do not represent the definition of subtraction.

mcqs.question: The triangle law of vector addition states that:

options.A: The resultant of two vectors is represented by the diagonal of the parallelogram constructed on them.
options.B: When two vectors are placed head‑to‑tail, the vector joining the tail of the first to the head of the second is the resultant.
options.C: Vectors can be added only if they are collinear.
options.D: The magnitude of the resultant is the sum of the magnitudes of the two vectors.

mcqs.answer: When two vectors are placed head‑to‑tail, the vector joining the tail of the first to the head of the second is the resultant.
mcqs.explanation: The triangle law uses a head‑to‑tail arrangement; the straight line joining the free tail to the free head gives the resultant. Option A describes the parallelogram law, while C and D are incorrect statements about vector addition.

mcqs.question: A boat can move 5 km/h eastward in still water. If a current of 3 km/h flows northward, the actual displacement of the boat after 2 h is best found using which law?
mcqs.explanation: The boat’s velocity and the current’s velocity are two vectors acting simultaneously from the same point. Placing them tail‑to‑tail forms a parallelogram; the diagonal gives the resultant velocity. Hence the parallelogram law is the appropriate graphical method. The component method would also work mathematically, but the question asks for the law.

mcqs.question: Three forces of 10 N, 15 N and 20 N act sequentially head‑to‑tail and the last head meets the first tail, forming a closed triangle. Which law is used to verify that the forces are in equilibrium?
mcqs.explanation: When three or more vectors are placed head‑to‑tail and the final head returns to the initial tail, they form a closed polygon. The polygon law states that the resultant of such a set is zero, indicating equilibrium. Triangle law applies only to two vectors, and the parallelogram law to two vectors placed tail‑to‑tail.

mcqs.question: A wind exerts a force of 30 N due east on a kite, while another gust of 40 N blows at 30° north of east. What is the magnitude (in N) and direction (angle north of east) of the resultant force?
mcqs.explanation: Resolve the second gust: \(40\cos30°≈34.64\) N east, \(40\sin30°=20\) N north. Adding east components: 30 N + 34.64 N = 64.64 N. North component = 20 N. Resultant magnitude = \(\sqrt{64.64^2+20^2}\approx67.7\) N. Direction \(\theta=\arctan(20/64.64)≈17.2°\) north of east. Option A matches these values.
